about.pageDescription: Erfahren Sie mehr über Asteria Diamond House und die Gründerin Diana Angelaki.
about.founderBio: Diana Angelaki (officially Diana Koubatiadou Angelaki) is Co-Founder & CEO of Asteria Diamond House in Thessaloniki, Greece, and also the founder of Diana Lux Travel.
about.houseDescription: Asteria Diamond House bietet einen ruhigen, durchdachten Weg zu Ihrem Diamanten — zertifizierte Steine, fachkundige Beratung und Ringe um Ihre Geschichte. Wir konzentrieren uns allein auf Diamanten, damit jedes Detail seinen Platz verdient.
about.chapter1Body: Diana Angelaki hat Asteria aus einem Leben geformt, das von Reisen, Handwerk und stillem Luxus geprägt ist. Neben Diana Lux Travel gründete sie ein Diamanthaus für Steine mit Absicht — nie in Eile.
about.chapter2Body: Asteria Diamond House widmet sich allein Diamanten: zertifizierte Steine, fachkundige Beratung und Ringe um Ihre Geschichte. Jedes Detail hat seinen Platz — ruhig, durchdacht und persönlich.
about.chapter3Body: Ihr Ring beginnt mit einem Diamanten und wird zu etwas, das nur Sie tragen können. Gestalten Sie mit uns oder buchen Sie eine private Beratung — wir gehen den Weg mit Ihnen.
about.coFounderBio: Ruslana Kabiyeva is Co-Founder & CFO of Asteria Diamond House, guiding the house’s operations and growth alongside the creative vision of the brand.

what-are-lab-grown-diamonds.metaTitle: What Are Lab-Grown Diamonds? | Asteria Guides
what-are-lab-grown-diamonds.metaDescription: Understand lab-grown diamonds — real diamonds grown in a laboratory — and how Asteria uses them in jewelry in Greece.
what-are-lab-grown-diamonds.title: What Are Lab-Grown Diamonds?
what-are-lab-grown-diamonds.intro: Lab-grown diamonds are diamonds created in controlled conditions. Chemically and optically they are diamonds — with a different origin story than mined stones.
what-are-lab-grown-diamonds.section1Body: Lab-grown diamonds share the same crystal structure as natural diamonds. They can be graded for cut, color, clarity, and carat, and set into fine jewelry just as mined stones are.
what-are-lab-grown-diamonds.section2Body: Lab-grown diamonds allow us to focus on design, color, and craftsmanship — including vivid colored stones — while keeping each piece transparent about origin and certification.
what-are-lab-grown-diamonds.section3Body: Browse colored lab-grown diamond jewelry or rings from our Thessaloniki house, or read on about how colored stones are created.

colored-lab-grown-diamonds.metaDescription: How colored lab-grown diamonds work — blue, yellow, pink — and how to explore Asteria jewelry in Greece.
colored-lab-grown-diamonds.title: Colored Lab-Grown Diamonds
colored-lab-grown-diamonds.intro: Color is one of the most expressive qualities in a diamond. Lab-grown technology makes blue, yellow, and pink hues more accessible without sacrificing diamond identity.
colored-lab-grown-diamonds.section1Body: Colored lab-grown diamonds are selected for tone and saturation that suit the metal and silhouette. At Asteria we present color clearly on every product page.
colored-lab-grown-diamonds.section2Body: Each hue has its own character: blue for cool depth, yellow for warmth, pink for soft radiance. Dedicated collection pages help you start with the color you love.
colored-lab-grown-diamonds.section3Body: Visit Colored Lab-Grown Diamond Jewelry in Greece, then open the blue, yellow, or pink landing pages to see available pieces.

lab-grown-vs-natural-diamonds.metaTitle: Lab-Grown vs Natural Diamonds | Asteria Guides
lab-grown-vs-natural-diamonds.metaDescription: A clear comparison of lab-grown and natural diamonds — and how Asteria presents both stories honestly.
lab-grown-vs-natural-diamonds.title: Lab-Grown vs Natural Diamonds
lab-grown-vs-natural-diamonds.intro: Both lab-grown and natural diamonds are diamonds. The difference lies in origin, supply story, and often in access to certain colors and sizes.
lab-grown-vs-natural-diamonds.section1Body: Hardness, brilliance, and grading language are shared. A well-cut lab-grown diamond and a well-cut natural diamond can look equally luminous on the hand.
lab-grown-vs-natural-diamonds.section2Body: Natural diamonds formed over geological time; lab-grown diamonds are grown in weeks or months. Asteria focuses on lab-grown diamonds, including colored stones, with certificates when provided.
lab-grown-vs-natural-diamonds.section3Body: If you want colored lab-grown diamond jewelry in Greece, start with our colored collection or book a consultation in Thessaloniki.

how-colored-lab-grown-diamonds-are-creat.metaTitle: How Colored Lab-Grown Diamonds Are Created | Asteria
how-colored-lab-grown-diamonds-are-creat.metaDescription: A plain-language look at how colored lab-grown diamonds gain blue, yellow, or pink hues.
how-colored-lab-grown-diamonds-are-creat.title: How Colored Lab-Grown Diamonds Are Created
how-colored-lab-grown-diamonds-are-creat.intro: Color in lab-grown diamonds comes from controlled growth conditions and, in some cases, post-growth treatments documented by laboratories.
how-colored-lab-grown-diamonds-are-creat.section1Body: Methods such as HPHT and CVD grow diamond carbon into a crystal. Trace elements or lattice conditions can introduce color during growth.
how-colored-lab-grown-diamonds-are-creat.section2Body: Independent labs describe the final color appearance. When Asteria jewelry includes a report, we link it so you can verify what the laboratory observed.
how-colored-lab-grown-diamonds-are-creat.section3Body: Explore blue, yellow, and pink lab-grown diamond pages, or the full colored jewelry collection from our Greek house.

igi-certification.metaDescription: What IGI certification means for lab-grown diamonds at Asteria Diamond House.
igi-certification.title: IGI Certification
igi-certification.intro: IGI reports are commonly used for lab-grown diamonds. They record the stone’s identity and quality grades.
igi-certification.section1Body: Expect details such as carat weight, color, clarity, cut (when applicable), measurements, and a unique report number.
igi-certification.section2Body: When a piece is paired with an IGI report, we show the lab, report number, and a link to the official record whenever available.
igi-certification.section3Body: Read how to interpret a certificate, or browse colored lab-grown diamond jewelry from Thessaloniki.

how-to-read-a-diamond-certificate.metaTitle: How to Read a Diamond Certificate | Asteria Guides
how-to-read-a-diamond-certificate.metaDescription: A practical guide to reading diamond certificates for lab-grown and colored stones.
how-to-read-a-diamond-certificate.title: How to Read a Diamond Certificate
how-to-read-a-diamond-certificate.intro: A certificate is a laboratory’s record of a diamond. Learning its sections helps you compare stones calmly.
how-to-read-a-diamond-certificate.section1Body: Carat, color, clarity, and cut sit at the center. For fancy colors, the color description may replace the D–M white scale. Measurements and proportions complete the picture.
how-to-read-a-diamond-certificate.section2Body: Use the report number on the laboratory’s website to confirm the document matches the stone described on the jewelry page.
how-to-read-a-diamond-certificate.section3Title: Shop with the report in mind
how-to-read-a-diamond-certificate.section3Body: Asteria product pages surface certificate fields when present. Continue to colored lab-grown diamonds or rings when you are ready.

diamond-cuts-and-shapes.metaDescription: Oval, round, cushion, and more — how diamond shapes relate to Asteria jewelry design.
diamond-cuts-and-shapes.title: Diamond Cuts & Shapes
diamond-cuts-and-shapes.intro: Shape is the silhouette you see; cut quality is how well that shape returns light. Both matter in lab-grown diamond jewelry.
diamond-cuts-and-shapes.section1Body: Round, oval, cushion, emerald, pear, and other shapes each change how color and brilliance read on the hand — especially with blue, yellow, or pink stones.
diamond-cuts-and-shapes.section2Body: Solitaires, halos, and bezel settings frame shapes differently. Asteria product pages list the diamond shape so you can compare pieces easily.
diamond-cuts-and-shapes.section3Body: Browse rings and colored lab-grown diamond jewelry, or ask for a custom shape when you book a consultation.
